---
name: bmad-prd
description: Create or refine a proportionate product requirements document for a feature in this RAG application. Use when asked to define product requirements, users, scope, or success criteria.
---

# Product requirements

Help the user define the feature rather than silently deciding product tradeoffs.
Read `README.md`, `HANDOFF.md`, and relevant code to ground the requirements.

Capture the user problem, target users, key workflows, in-scope and out-of-scope
behavior, acceptance criteria, security/privacy needs, and measurable success
criteria. Ask only the clarifying questions that materially affect the result.
Keep an MVP brief short; do not introduce enterprise requirements without a
reason. Write a PRD only when requested, and use the user's preferred location.

For implementation details, hand off to `bmad-spec` or `bmad-architecture`.
